title: Time tracker raw properties expose stale authoritative-looking state
description: Correctness/robustness review: StratumTracker.timestamp returns the unprojected accepted timestamp, while timestamp/stratum/sample do not apply expiry until another method happens to run. Callers can observe stale wall-clock and active-looking stratum contrary to authoritative-read requirements. Remove or rename these as explicit raw diagnostics and require current_time/status(now), or bind a monotonic clock so every public state read expires first. Add idle-read expiry coverage.
